video-based.title: What is a CMS?
video-based.description: CMS stands for video content management system. It is basically software that lets you upload, organize, and deliver video content from one central location. Miestro’s CMS makes it very simple and easy to upload and manage videos.

video-based.title: How does Miestro’s video CMS work?
video-based.description: Miestro’s content management system lets you upload and manage all of your videos from one central admin area. Any changes you make to your videos, collections, or extras will be made right away on your site and all your apps.

video-based.title: Do I need a website host or video host to use Miestro to share content?
video-based.description: Nope. All of that is taken care of for you by us. All you have to do is upload your content, and we'll take care of hosting, which is covered by the price of your package.

video-based.title: Do I own the rights to everything I post and store?
video-based.description: Yes! You own your audience and all of your assets, content, and data. Miestro is just a way for you to make money off of your videos.

membership.title: What is a membership site?
membership.description: A membership site is where customers pay a monthly subscription fee to access information and resources.

membership.title: What are the benefits of a membership site?
membership.description: You create a base of loyal customers who are more receptive to your offerings and eager to buy and learn from you. In addition, you create a stable, recurrent income stream that you can count on receiving month in and month out.

membership.title: What does a good membership site have?
membership.description: Most importantly, your membership site should offer access to high-quality content that tangibly benefits subscribers.

membership.title: How does Miestro help my membership site succeed?
membership.description: We provide the templates and processes you need to operate a highly efficient, highly profitable membership site. You don't have to worry about trial and error. With Miestro, you get a site that is optimized for member ease of use and satisfaction.
